notes.title: ERRORS WHEN TRYING TO PLAY 💥
notes.notes:
Hello everybody, how are you? How did you start 2025?

We are aware of some troubles that are ocurring recently in The Black Heart when you try to play the game from the Steam library. You can easily fix this by playing the game from its directory and opening the "TheBlackHeart.exe" file.

To find that directory, you need to right click the game from the Steam libreary > Properties > Installed Files > Browse...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/0e43cf5352c3e06a7888b0802e78feed214a232d.png[/img]
The errors when trying to play the game from Steam are probably related to a recent Steam update which has troubles with the current version of the engine The Black Heart is using.

We're trying to fix that but it requires some external work since its related to the engine, not the game. In the mid time, you can continue playing the game from the directory like we said above.

We're sorry for these, but it's something that exceeds us and we've been told about it this week. We have already contacted Steam, but didn't get any response yet.

Cheers from the team, have a great year!

[i]Tobías and Andrés[/i]

notes.title: 🚨 New game Out of Bounds is NOW AVAILABLE! 🚨
notes.notes:
[b]Hello, everybody! How have you been?[/b]

We're doing PRETTY WELL! Closing this crazy 2022 celebrating 🥳

And that's not only because [url=https://edition.cnn.com/2022/12/20/sport/argentina-football-team-arrival-intl-hnk-spt]our football team won the World Cup[/url], but also because we have just released a new game on Steam:

[url=https://youtu.be/U7Q1M-wRbMg][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/53ceb798e992c68ae96c207c36012d92b474fc5d.png[/img][/url]

Out of Bounds is a peculiar title that was originally created for a game jam the past year ([url=https://itch.io/jam/2021-epic-megajam]Epic Megajam 2021[/url]). As a solo dev, I had 7 days to create a game that was later [url=https://tobiasrusjan.itch.io/out-of-bounds]released for free on Itchio[/url].

Since I liked the result of the jam, I decided to keep working on that idea for the next months and also some great devs (former colleagues from other projects) joined me to get the best results in visuals ([url=https://twitter.com/viktorahmed]Viktor Ahmed[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/scuzzostuff/]Claudio "Scuzzo" Sagrera[/url]) and audio ([url=https://twitter.com/davyd_music]David Levill[/url]) 🙌



[h1]THE GAME[/h1]

Out of Bounds is a title about "creating" a game and "fixing" bugs... Yeah, it's crazy. You will pickup blueprints, compile shaders, test sound effects, drink a lot of coffee. But watch out for the bugs! Grab your Line Tracer and get rid of them 👾

https://youtu.be/U7Q1M-wRbMg
Things are starting to get better here in Saibot Studios and Out of Bounds is part of that process. I'm looking forward to bring you news about bigger projects in the future, but for now give a chance to this crazy puzzle shooter with humor and puzzles 🤓

You can follow Out of Bounds on its new Twitter account:
https://twitter.com/OutOfBoundsVg



[h1]NEWS ABOUT EXPLOSIONS AND GORE?[/h1]

Hell yeah! The people at [url=https://www.humblebundle.com/]Humble Bundle[/url] created [url=https://www.humblebundle.com/games/holiday-encore-best-boomer-shooters-bundle]a new package of retro style first person shooters[/url] based on the one they did in March of this year 🔥

[url=https://www.humblebundle.com/games/holiday-encore-best-boomer-shooters-bundle][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/d71afde69b8306dbbb108c8e6fbcb9e42f3a60d0.png[/img][/url]

This time, you can get 7 awesome titles for only 12 dollars, including our own [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/753590/Hellbound/]Hellbound[/url] and the great [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1590910/Forgive_Me_Father/]Forgive Me Father[/url] was also added to the list.

A percentage of the sales will go to charity at [url=https://ablegamers.org/]Able Gamers[/url] and [url=https://www.starlight.org/]Starlight Children's Foundation[/url] ❤️

Hurry up! Get the bundle before the next 24 hours ⏲️



If you have a Twitter account, don't forget to follow us for more news:
https://twitter.com/SaibotStudios

Cheers and take care!

notes.title: 📦 COLLECTION + SPECIAL VIDEO + MORE! 🪙
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/28189/][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/2baf71e0692653c469784f5518da8d0bd44810da.png[/img][/url]


[h1]Hello there! How are you? How's your 2022 so far? 😎[/h1]

From here, we have a few things to tell you...

As we mentioned you in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/SaibotStudios/announcements/detail/3123813809682672635]last post[/url], this year we reached an entire decade since we started making games as an independent team in Saibot Studios. But it was just now that we actually make something special to celebrate it. [url=https://youtu.be/S4-E40ce_Oo]Check out the special video![/url]

https://youtu.be/S4-E40ce_Oo

Together with this video, we built and launched a collection with all our published games, including: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/search/?franchise=Doorways]the Doorways saga[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/753590/Hellbound/]Hellbound[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1431780/The_Black_Heart/]The Black Heart[/url] 😈

[b]> [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/28189/]LINK TO BUNDLE[/url] <[/b]

Buying the games from the bundle, gives you a 15% of discount on all the titles. And if you already have one or more of the games included in the package, it will discount you the titles you're missing without needing to buy the entire bundle 👌



[h1]TENEBRIS SOMNIA[/h1]

On the other hand, we receently announced our new creation: Tenebris Somnia. This is a very unique title by the great [url=https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Andr%C3%A9s_Borghi]Andrés Borghi[/url], creator of The Black Heart 🖤

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2121510/Tenebris_Somnia/][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/3dc732cee7c111bb33503e507a649dcf3d66ae79.png[/img][/url]

We're developing this project Andrés and I ([url=https://twitter.com/TobiasRusjan]Tobías Rusjan[/url]), together with a great team of artists. You can read more about it and the dev team [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2121510/view/3307354336731266403]in this other post[/url] we did the past week.

If you like the concept of the game, don't forget to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2121510/Tenebris_Somnia/]add it to your Wishlists[/url]. We're aiming to have it ready during 2023 👍

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2121510/Tenebris_Somnia/



[h1]OUT OF BOUNDS[/h1]

In the mean time, I keep working on my little jam game Out of Bounds, a rare title with action, shooting and puzzles. We released a demo in June and it's still available to check directly from the store page:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1787100/Out_of_Bounds/][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/53ceb798e992c68ae96c207c36012d92b474fc5d.png[/img][/url]

My idea is finish the full game for the end of the year. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1787100/Out_of_Bounds/]So play the demo and add it to your wishlist if you liked it![/url] 🙌

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1787100/Out_of_Bounds/



[h1]HELLBOUND... HELLBOUND?[/h1]

This month we received the great news from our (now) former publishers that they're giving us back the IP of Hellbound 🤯

What does this mean?

Finally, we at Saibot Studios are going to start receiving sales from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/753590/Hellbound/]Hellbound[/url] on Steam. Since the release of 2020, all the sales went to the publisher because that was what we stablished: they recoup their investment first, and then we split; but we never reached that last step because they never recoup their part with the sales we had.

But now after two years from the release, they're giving us back the game so we can atleast see some of the sales. Also, we got back the full rights of the project to take any desision we want from now on 🔥

[url=https://youtu.be/ndqIlyYFVJM][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/5d56edecbe4128de8d9912896496161a814e16f3.png[/img][/url]

In March of this year there was the Best of Boomer Shooters Bundle, the first collection of Humble Bundle focused on retro FPSs. Hellbound had the honour to be included in that package, becoming the first argentinian game in participate in the iconic Humble Bundle:

https://youtu.be/ndqIlyYFVJM

Both the sales from this collection and also the sales from now on (September of 2022) at Steam are going to us at Saibot. Yes, finally!

But unfortunately, this aren't earnings for us yet, since we still need to recoup all we put to create the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/802200/Hellbound_Survival_Mode/]Hellbound: Survival Mode[/url] in 2016-2018.

So the future of Hellbound is still uncertain... The good thing is that everything has started looking brighter now, we'll see how things turn for our Hellgore in the next months 🤞



That would be all for now, people. Hope we have some more news for you soon, follow us in our networks to stay updated:

[*] [url=https://www.instagram.com/saibotstudios/]Instagram [/url]

[/list]

Cheers, everybody! Take care!

[i]Tobias[/i]

notes.title: 🎂 10 YEARS OF SAIBOT! 🎉
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/7b810cd997a89e0c3e44b1a3488243164ef329ce.png[/img]



[h1]Hello, people! How are you? How did you started 2022? 🤓[/h1]


In a day like today, but from 2012, we officially started a crazy adventure called [url=http://saibotstudios.com]Saibot[/url] that continues to date.

Actually, the very begginning was in 2011 with the conceptualization and prototype of what ended up being our first title Doorways ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/SaibotStudios/announcements/detail/3039340060183828773]read more[/url]).


But it wasn't until March of 2012 that, after I partened with my Uncle and friend Ivan Rusjan, we finally started working as a team. We built the first Saibot "office", which was actually my room along side the bed and at my Mom's department, and we used some old tables as desks that my Grandma gave us ❤️

And from then, a lot of enechdotes and experiences started hapenning. With tons of fails and drop downs, but also with some wins, we were able to keep going to date doing what we love the most: creating our own games and delivering them all over the world 🌎

So I decided to take some time to build and share with you a quick recap of some of the main milestones we have achieved together with you during the last 10 years of Saibot...



[h1]2012: The Origin[/h1]
[list]
[*] Started the team and office with only two members (picture)

[*] Started the development of the first game and saga: [url=https://doorwaysgame.com/]Doorways[/url]

[*] First public presentation of the game at the event EVA 2012
[/list]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/d9a7ea9b6833fb127135c0a1ac1a73a9c7a57c20.jpg[/img]

[i]Left: Tobias Rusjan (me), right: Martin Voychisko[/i]



[h1]2013: Prelude[/h1]
[list]
[*] Trip to E3 thanks to a contest we won at Indies Crash E3

[*] Official launch of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/248470/Doorways_Prelude/]Doorways: Prelude[/url] on Steam (first argentinian game to be released on Steam after being approved on Greenlight)

[*] Launch of VR (virtual reality) version of Doorways: Prelude with the Oculus Rift Dev Kit 1 (first argentinian game published with VR compatibility)

[u]Lista completa de ajustes y mejoras en la nueva versión 1.5[/u]

[*] Improved Practice mode with more options.
[*] Fixed image bug in movelists.
[*] Added macros to execute double punch or kick with 1 key.
[*] Updated engine to Ikemen_GO_v0.98.1
[*] In Practice mode you can choose any stage.
[*] Changed background animation in options menu.
[*] Every normal launcher can be blocked mid-air.
[*] Fatal moves performed in Practice mode don't produce bugs.
[*] Killer modes executed mid-combo consume half a green bar for every character.
[*] Normal weak jumping attacks produce more stunts to standing enemies to facilitate combos.
[/list]

Peketo:
[list]
[*] "tele-cut" uses 2 different animations varying between weak or strong.
[*] "Tele-cut" is slightly slower.
[/list]

Ananzi:
[list]
[*] "Super crawling birth" bounces only 2 times before disappearing.
[*] "Super crawling birth" allows only 1 egg onscreen.
[*] "Arachnid requiem" is faster and produces slightly more damage.
[*] Animation for "Super black trap" is a little faster during HIT.
[*] "Prey" is now overhead.
[*] You need more distance from the enemy to execute "Black trap".
[/list]

Animus:
[list]
[*] Weak "Nadasdy spear" now leaves the enemy closer when hit.
[*] JP-HK in dash is not overhead anymore.
[/list]

Shar-makai:
[list]
[*] "Saliva attack" is now a hard knockdown.
[*] St-hp has more reach.
[*] Fatal move has more reach and is unblockable.
[*] "Small army" allows to continue the combo.
[*] Jp-lp has cooldown to prevent constant spamming.
[*] Worm spawned in "Rock skull" now dies if Shar-makai is hit.
[*] St-hk is now overhead, except during combo.
[/list]

Hashi:
[list]
[*] "Seeding" tree now has more pushback when blocked.
[/list]

Noroko:
[list]
[*] "Snow woman" can be executed only 2 times without touching the floor.
[*] Reduced juggle.
[*] "Soul Punishment", "Bloody end" and "Kwaidan" have more recovery.
[/list]

Final:
[list]
[*] "Sanguimancy" clones now die after a certain time.
[/list]

Janos:
[list]
[*] Fixed some hitboxes
[*] "Negative saw is now executable in mid-air and is now a launcher.
[*] Projectiles in "Black blade" and "Black blades shred" are destroyed when clashing against an enemy projectile.
[*] "Dark puppet" clon has less life and last less time.
[*] There can only be 1 "Dark Puppet" onscreen.
[/list]

notes.title: Fact 2: Mugen (2009) 👾
notes.notes:
In 2003, Andres found the world of Mugen.

It was a fighting engine where creators from all around the world added characters from different universes to fight each other in epic never seen battles: from Goku vs. Superman, to Ronald Mcdonald vs. Homer Simpson...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/2f820c5f37d9e7d6d000209f87d83755ffdc15be.jpg[/img]


But Andres wanted to create his own characters. At the beginning he wasn't actually thinking about creating a full game, but building only his individual creatures.

The community loved them! So Andres decided to get things to the next level 😎

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/b9bea6fea7760093285a7d267ade59440e8af200.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/e41f117f6b10dd679c3ca995e36303c8ab3a34f8.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/870cb8cdf94ffad572a38c12d6a2c56e4a39d8a8.jpg[/img]


Andres created the story for each character and then a story in common titled "El Corazón Negro" (The Black Heart) 🖤

Then designed all the sprites, interfaces and cinematics; recorded the male voices; built the sound effects; and composed most of the soundtracks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/adf7b52a92af85f3e59980f167b06eee98cc27c9.jpg[/img]


After six years of hard work (October of 2009), Andres published the first playable version of The Black Heart on Game Jolt 🙌

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/7e8dbad7a6f847cb8d1d589a3144243905fc210c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/c76a33e3124ec9ab61670c41a2c143aaa181115f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/2e9eb08d17e12447fb1e3c9f79688da679132716.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/f0655d2f0da514c0a32d2591581fb90f6ee6ec26.jpg[/img]


And a decade later, he returned to his creation and ported the game to the Ikemen engine so we all can play The Black Heart in its final form on Steam 👽

notes.title: Chapter 3: The red dream (Peketo) 🔪
notes.notes:
Creatures from the other world! How have you been? 💀

From the release on October, Andrés has been working on The Black Heart to bring you this new and terrorific update with "The red dream"...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/8d5c2837ff2b2b38b0eca6667e77ccc9d19d7b80.jpg[/img]

The third chapter of the story mode with Peketo is now available!

Also, a lot of fixes and improvements has been made based on your awesome feedback. Thanks for that!
So below is the full list of changes in this new version 1.3-EA2.

We're also trying to add new game modes, but we depend on the progress of the engine Ikemen for that. Hope we have news soon 🤞

Cheers and let's go cover in blood once again!

[i]Tobías[/i]

-

Full list of chances and improvements from new version 1.3-EA2:

- Third chapter of the story mode added (Peketo).
- Updated to the latest version of the Ikemen engine (V.96).
- Added 32 bit version (x86).
- Movelist is easier to understand.
- Screenshot folder added (F12 to generate a screenshot).
- Controls are more responsive.
- The game starts in windowed mode to avoid crashes (ALT+ENTER for fullscreen)
- Minimum distance for throws increased from 3 to 10 pixels.
- Animus' killer mode fire animation improved.
- Survival mode specifies which match you are in.
- The survival mode result screen includes both characters when in team mode.
- The survival mode result screen and continue screen have music.
- Time in matches increased to 99 seconds.
- Ananzi's killer mode improved.
- Continue option text reads better.
- Final boss' teleport spam limited.
- Noroko's Obon supermove can't hit enemies if they block while crouching.
- Direct body special moves require more time to reset, leaving the attacker open to counter attacks.
- Final boss combat is now just 1 round with more time (120 seconds).
- Added visual and sound cue that indicates that the power bar is full.
- The damage of all attacks was rebalanced.
- Combo dampener system added to reduce the total damage of big combos.
- Spanish version has menues in spanish.
- Shar-makai's rising sting special attacks leaves the enemy open for more combos.
